# Post-clone setup steps (do these manually on GitHub.com)

1. Go to https://github.com/DevaanshKathuria/GitPulse
2. Click the gear icon next to "About"
3. Set description: "Semantic code intelligence platform -- hybrid search, AST parsing, PR risk scoring, contributor analytics"
4. Add topics: developer-tools, code-intelligence, typescript, ast, semantic-search, redis, bullmq, qdrant, elasticsearch, vector-search
5. Add website if deployed
